^JJ/r ORDAINED BYTHE CITY COUNCIL OE THE CITYOF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the Ml-2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District
symbols and indications as shown on Map 2-L in the area bounded by

         a line 530.21 feet west of and parallel to South Lavergne Avenue; West
         Harrison Street; a line 706.96 feet west of and parallel to South Lavergne
         Avenue; and the alley immediately north of and parallel to West Harrison
         Street

to those of an RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District and a
corresponding use district is hereby established in the area above described.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Common address of property:         5050-64 West Harrison Street
